title: Judge prompt includes voicePatterns, structure, and sample feel
description:
## Intent

The judge should think from house voice, not only tone/lexicon snippets.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Judge sees house voice
  As a copy-editing agent
  I want the OpenAI judge to receive voicePatterns, sentenceStyle, structure, and reference-sample feel
  So skip/rewrite judgment matches the publication, not generic editorial taste

  Scenario: Prompt carries voice
    Given a style profile with voicePatterns and reference samples
    When the OpenAI judge runs
    Then the judge request includes those fields (or excerpts)
    And it still does not rewrite the draft
```
